SCENARIO C — Mixed Load (Most Common Real Scenario)
One truck carries orders for multiple customers + some material for our godown
Load Breakdown — 10,000 KG in ONE Truck
Raj Printers (SO-2024-001) — 3,000 KG | Direct to Customer, Indore
Modern Packaging (SO-2024-003) — 2,000 KG | Direct to Customer, Dewas
Lasudia Godown (For Stock) — 5,000 KG | To Our Godown, Indore
Total: 10,000 KG | 3 Drops: Customer → Customer → Godown
Transporter: Rathi Roadways | Route: Bhadrachalam → Indore → Dewas
Drop 3: Lasudia Godown, Indore — 5,000 KG (For Stock)
3 drops: Raj Printers → Modern Pkg → Godown
Mill loads truck on 27-Jan-2024 & raises Mill Invoice MI-2024-003
TRK-MIX-001 | MH14CD9999 | Bhadrachalam → Indore → Dewas → Lasudia Godown
Mill dispatch completed — 10,000 KG loaded on MH14CD9999
En route to Indore | All 10,000 KG on board

Unloaded 2,000 KG | POD signed by Vikram Singh | Remaining: 5,000 KG

Route: Bhadrachalam → Nagpur → Indore (Drop 1) → Dewas (Drop 2) → Lasudia Godown (Drop 3)
─── After All Drops: Two Parallel Processes ───
Re-enters Dispatch Flow when SO arrives
Coverage ✓ → Dispatch Queue → Pick Plan → Challan → Deliver
Complete Data Trail — Mixed Load Scenario (C)
Coverage (0%) → PO-2024-005 (10,000 KG) → Mill Tracker (100%) → TLP-MILL-003 (Mixed, 3 drops)
→ Loading Instruction + Delivery Instruction (3 drops) → Mill Invoice MI-2024-003
→ Drop 1: Raj Printers (3,000 KG, POD ✓) → Drop 2: Modern Packaging (2,000 KG, POD ✓)
→ Drop 3: Lasudia Godown (5,000 KG) → GRN-2024-002 → LOT-2024-003 → Physical Stock
→ Sales Invoices: INV-2024-007 (Raj Printers) + INV-2024-008 (Modern Packaging) + Future SO for godown stock
Key Insight — Mixed Load is the Most Common Scenario
In real operations, a single truck from the mill typically carries material for 2-4 customers PLUS some for our godown.
The TLP (Truck Load Plan) handles multi-drop routing. After delivery, each drop is processed differently:
Customer drops → Sales Invoice directly (no GRN/stock lot), while godown drops → GRN → Stock Lot → future dispatch.
